title: [.NET] Add support for web export using static LibGodot
body:
This is an updated continuation of #118976, based on `NoctemCat:libgodot_mono_web`.

The original implementation commits and authorship are preserved. This branch adds:

- A merge of current `godotengine/master`, resolving the one conflict in `platform/web/export/export_plugin.cpp` by keeping the newer `p_notify`/`ExportNotifier` signature.
- A small cleanup for Python pre-3.12 compatibility in `platform_methods.py` (`delete_on_close=False` -> `delete=False`).
- A typo fix in `Browser.targets`.
- Documentation for the Web .NET / LibGodot template build flags.

## Validation

Environment:

- Windows 11
- Emscripten 3.1.56 from local emsdk
- Python 3.14 / SCons 4.10.1
- .NET SDKs 9.0.310 and 10.0.100 installed

Non-threaded Web .NET template:

```sh
scons platform=web target=template_debug module_mono_enabled=yes arch=wasm32 \
    library_type=static_library threads=no lto=none disable_crash_handler=yes -j8
```

Produced:

```text
bin/godot.web.template_debug.wasm32.nothreads.mono.zip   42,989,789 bytes
bin/libgodot.web.template_debug.wasm32.nothreads.a       176,889,360 bytes
```

Threaded Web .NET template:

```sh
scons platform=web target=template_debug module_mono_enabled=yes arch=wasm32 \
    library_type=static_library threads=yes proxy_to_pthread=yes lto=none \
    disable_crash_handler=yes -j8
```

Produced:

```text
bin/godot.web.template_debug.wasm32.mono.zip   43,025,654 bytes
bin/libgodot.web.template_debug.wasm32.a       176,676,002 bytes
```

Both zips contain the expected LibGodot payload:

```text
libgodot/libgodot.a
libgodot/config.json
libgodot/js_library/*.js
libgodot/pre_js/callMain_stub.js
libgodot/post_js/patch_em_gl.js
```

## Disclosure

This PR was prepared with AI assistance. The branch is based on #118976, and the original implementation authorship is preserved in the commit history. The merge resolution, cleanup, docs, and local build validation were performed in this checkout.
